statements.status_notes: Waiting for upstream logstash to update uri gem dependency to 0.12.4. CVE-2025-27221 affects uri gem 0.12.3 requiring upgrade to 0.12.4. However, Ruby gems in the logstash image are managed by the upstream logstash Gradle build process using installDefaultGems, not directly controllable at the image definition level. The logstash build installs gems from the official logstash repository's gem specifications, making gem version overrides dependent on upstream logstash changes.
